subject: Credit memo allocation & revenue split for Q2 tax accrual
messages:
From: BillingOps@nimbusanalytics.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credit memo CM-442 misapplied to revenue - VAT mismatch

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads up — we discovered that credit memo CM-442 (attached) was applied against invoice 789 but it looks like our AP system posted the VAT reversal to the wrong liability code, which left a €3,120 VAT accrual shortfall on your side. Customer (Acme Analytics) expects the credit to be applied against the services portion of their subscription, but our team applied it fully to product license revenue.

We need a reallocation on your GL so VAT is reversed correctly and revenue recognition for Q2 is accurate. Attached: CM-442.pdf and remittance_202607.pdf. Can you confirm whether Redwood will reclass the CM or if you prefer us to issue a corrected credit?

Apologies for the scramble — Brian Lee (BillingOps)
[Attachment: CM-442.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]
[Attachment: remittance_202607.pdf (PDF, 54KB)]

From: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
To: BillingOps@nimbusanalytics.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit memo CM-442 misapplied to revenue - VAT mismatch

Thanks Brian — and thanks for the attachments. Looping in Marcus and Marissa from Finance/AR to assess GL impact.

Proposal from our side: we will reallocate CM-442 on our books rather than ask for a replacement on your end. Preliminary split: 60% to Services (SVC_REV) and 40% to Product (PRD_REV), which should align tax treatment with how the original invoice was structured. We also want the VAT reversal to flow out of VAT_PAYABLE and tie into a VAT offset entry so month-end accruals match.

Marcus — can you draft the adjusting journal entries and confirm the net impact on AR aging? Marissa — can you advise on whether we should apply the CM partially to invoice 790 (open) and issue a small customer-facing credit memo for the remainder?

If any of you see a blocker, flag it here — ideally we post before month-end.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: CM-442.pdf (as provided by Nimbus)]

From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0700

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Proposal from our side: we will reallocate CM-442 on our books rather than ask for a replacement on your end.

Agree — reclass on our side is cleaner. Draft entries below (gross amounts shown, VAT @20% assumed):

1) Reverse original recognition (partial):
   Dr Product Revenue (PRD_REV)  €12,000
   Cr Accounts Receivable (AR)   €12,000

2) Recognize services portion reduction and VAT reversal:
   Dr Services Revenue (SVC_REV) €18,000
   Dr VAT Payable (VAT_PAYABLE) €3,600
   Cr Accounts Receivable (AR)   €21,600

3) VAT accrual correction (to clear shortfall):
   Dr VAT Expense / Accrual Adj  €3,120
   Cr VAT Payable                €3,120

Net AR reduction: €33,600 (matches CM gross).

I've put the posting draft into gl-journal-draft.xlsx (attached) with GL codes mapped to our chart of accounts. Recommend post date 2026-08-31 to preserve month-end balances; if customer needs immediate cash application we can post an interim batch and reverse at month close.

Note: confirm with FinanceOps if we need to include a revenue recognition memo for Audit traces.

Marcus Lin
Senior Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: gl-journal-draft.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)]

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit memo CM-442 misapplied to revenue - VAT mismatch

Thanks Marcus — that layout looks good. A couple of practical notes from AR: 

- Invoice 790 is open for €8,400 gross. We can apply CM-442 to invoice 790 up to that amount (reduces AR immediately) and create a customer-facing credit for the residual.
- Applying partially will reduce our DSO exposure quicker; remittance from Nimbus indicates they expected full offset but are ok with internal reallocation.
- I'll prepare the customer credit and the AR adjustment once Marcus confirms GL mapping and provides the final posting date.

Quick ask: can we avoid creating a new AR aging bucket? I'd prefer to keep the original invoice aging unchanged and move the remainder to a 'customer credit' clearing account until it's issued.

Marissa Cole
AR Manager | Redwood Inference

- Marissa: create the customer credit and let BillingOps know expected timing.
